clips.title: The story
paras: The Clockwerk Run is the main entrance corridor leading into the heart of fallen Gnomeregan. Stretching between the Train Depot and the Hall of Gears, this damaged hallway is heavily contaminated by toxic fallout and overrun with irradiated troggs.

Serving as the primary gateway into Gnomeregan from the outer train depot, the Clockwerk Run was once a bustling conduit of gnomish logistics and transit. When High Tinker Mekkatorque ordered the venting of radioactive waste to stem the trogg invasion, the corridor became a lethal trap. The blast and subsequent fighting caused portions of the hallway to collapse onto itself. Today, the passage is choked with toxic fumes and prowling irradiated troggs, making it the perilous frontline that any expedition must fight through to reach the upper Hall of Gears.
